fields.description: Program Description This course is taught by School of Business Administration Why Choose To Study This Program With its information technology, management, professional knowledge and good English communication skills, It often attend some international conferences and international events, such as bipolar conference, Harvard University, harvard business "model United Nations" conference, Norway international student section (ISFIT), bayer ECO - young MINDS environment BBS, etc., and students have been selected as bayer youth ambassador for the environment. Course Language course: Intensive reading, extensive reading and heard, writing, translation, British and American national culture and literature, English, advanced interpretation, etc. After four years of study, students can master English in listening, speaking, reading, writing and translating of language skills, and to study a second foreign language. Students in grade two and grade four, respectively, to participate in the test for English majors 4 and 8, through the recognized certificate of English professional 4, 8. Academic course: computer system structure, data structure, database principle and application, computer network and management information system, information system analysis and design, program design, ERP, marketing, operations management, macroeconomics, management, e-commerce, multinational management, cross-cultural management, organizational behavior, etc. In addition, students can take business management, public relations and professional elective courses. Some specialized courses adopt the internationally used English original edition teaching material, and use English or bilingual teaching. Length of Schooling: 4 years Admission only available in Fall Semester, opening in September The exact opening date is available in Acceptance Letter. Career Students can go to PWC, Deloitte, Ernst & Young, KPMG and other international well-known accounting firm work, and also can go to IBM, Shanghai and other famous IT companies, or Bank of China, Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, foreign banks and multinationals such as Unilever, Procter & Gamble. The graduates both specialized in English and information management technology, and in the job market they have obvious competitive advantage; they will be welcomed by choose and employment faculties. Application Deadline For the programs in Hongkou Campus by June 30 Completion of Program Diploma and Certificate of Bachelor\'s Degree will be issued to those who have completed the undergraduate program with qualified academic standing. Notes 1) This major won’t be available unless there is an enrollment of 10 or above. 2) The financial support and custody may be student\'s parents or relatives in Shanghai. 3) Tuition and any other fees are not refundable once they have been paid to SISU.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Certificate of No Criminal Conviction * 2. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. -Chinese and Mathematics test results are required. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1) High school qualification or above, with an age between 18 to 35. Applicants who are under 18 years old as of September 1, 2026 must submit a Guardian’s Guarantee Letter (download link below). The guardian must be an adult living in China with a stable source of income. 2) In good physical and mental conditions; with reliable guardian for economic guarantee. Non-Chinese citizens with valid foreign passport. 3) Following students should meet the conditions set by the Document No. 12 (2020) of the Ministry of Education of the PRC: (1) Students emigrate from Mainland of China, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan and obtain the foreign nationality; (2) Students, whose parents (either or both) hold Chinese nationality and reside abroad, acquire foreign nationality at the time of birth. 4) Take the China Scholastic Competency Assessment (CSCA) test. When applying to our university, applicants must submit their CSCA test results. 5) If you studied or lived in China before, you should not have any record of violation of laws or disciplines. 6) Admission Requirements and Entrance Examinations Applicants must have Chinese proficiency of New HSK level 5. University Entrance examination include Chinese (oral test), English (oral and written tests). University Entrance examination is to be held on the last Saturday in April. For all the majors above, applicants should take CSCA Chinese and Math tests. For the following majors, applicants should also take CSCA in either Physics or Chemistry (choose one): Educational Technology, Actuarial Science, Data Science and Big Data Technology (Natural Language Processing and Financial Big Data). ★Students are not allowed to apply for their native language major.
